tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background of every chart, report and post. Warm paper in Paper theme, true terminal black in Terminal.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Card / chart plate sitting on paper. Always with a 1px line border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on panels, gridlines in charts, dividers above the source footer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, stat numbers and body text on paper or panel (12:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, chart labels, axis text, source and note footers on paper or panel (5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one highlight per view: the key bar, the base-case number, the takeaway word, links. Readable as text on paper and panel in both themes (Paper ~5:1, Terminal ~14:1).

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Secondary bars and the context series behind a signal bar. Decorative only: always pair with a value label, never use as text.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: The logo green. Fills on terminal black only: the logo, cover blocks, stickers, PFP rings. Never as text or a fill on paper.

tokens.name: terminal
tokens.usage: Logo ground and terminal-style blocks. Text on it is phosphor or ink in Terminal theme.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a signal fill (buttons, numbered step dots).

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Losses, drawdowns, rugs, and the second series when comparing against the signal series (e.g. NFTs vs memecoins). Darker than signal in Paper so the pair differs in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: loss-tint
tokens.usage: Background zones for a drawdown phase in cycle diagrams. Decorative only.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Unconfirmed, speculative or 'not yet' labels: no token confirmed, forecast windows. Text-safe in both themes.

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Background zone for the accumulation / no-one-cares phase and for 'not yet' shaded regions. Decorative only.

styles.name: grid-display
styles.usage: Decorative only: big background numerals, thumbnails, the Terminal face. Never for text people must read.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, legend swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Kicker to headline, stat to its label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a legend or key list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between header block and first panel.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Outer margin of a full infographic canvas.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Pixel elements: the logo grid, cover blocks, legend swatches, chart bars in Terminal theme.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chart bars in Paper theme, tags, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner step cards inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Outer panels / chart plates.

tokens.name: glow-phosphor
tokens.usage: CRT glow behind phosphor elements on terminal black only (logo, cover, stickers). Never on paper.
